import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    static final int N_MAX = 7;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0)
                v = v % MOD + MOD;

            if (v >= MOD)
                v %= MOD;

            val = (int) v;
        }

        static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;

            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                int temp2 = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp2;
            }

            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            this(v);
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            val += other.val;
            if (val >= MOD)
                val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            val -= other.val;
            if (val < 0)
                val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            val = fastMod((long) val * other.val);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return this.multiply(other.inv());
        }

        static int fastMod(uint64_t x, int m) {
            if (System.getProperty("os.name").startsWith("Windows")) {
                return (int) (x % m);
            }
            int xHigh = (int) (x >> 32);
            int xLow = (int) x;
            int quot, rem;
            rem = x % m;
            quot = (int) (xHigh * 1L * 1_000_000_000 + xLow);
            quot = quot / m;
            rem = rem / m;
            System.out.println(quot + " " + rem);
            return rem;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val, MOD));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert (p >= 0);
            ModInt a = this, result = new ModInt(1);

            while (p > 0) {
                if (p % 2 == 1)
                    result = result.multiply(a);

                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }

            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N_MAX][N_MAX];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N_MAX; i++)
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < 1 << N; mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = p.getKey();
                ModInt prob = p.getValue();

                long newPossible = 0;

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible & (1L << lookup[mask])) != 0) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0 && ((1 << i) & possible) != 0) {
                                newPossible |= 1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible & (1L << lookup[mask])) != 0) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0 && ((1 << i) & possible) != 0) {
                                newPossible |= 1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                newPossibleMasks.put(newPossible, newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(newPossible, new ModInt(0)).add(prob.multiply(probability[left][lookup[mask]])));
            }

            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.out.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);

        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> p : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if (((1L << N) - 1 & p.getKey()) != 0)
                answer = answer.add(p.getValue());
        }

        pw.println(answer);
        pw.close();
    }
}
